data.content_ref: inline:The target names a relation (contradiction) but its refutation condition mislocates the burden: it says the relation fails if the parity-exclusion route cannot independently determine the triple without appealing to 46. But a contradiction is refuted if the two routes are actually compatible — and they are. The mean derivation computes 46 and the parity-exclusion tests candidates near the mean, so the two routes do not exclude each other; the refutation test omits the compatibility pathway entirely.
